_provenance.note: Captured on the reference installation, verbatim (only _provenance added). captured_at comes from the device's own `common` block (local 16:47:07, Europe/Brussels). Shape facts: `inverters` is an ARRAY of {CID, DT, E_Total, ID, P} — the bundle could not tell, its client reading that member through Object.keys/Object.values; `site.MLoc` is the internal twin of the Solar API's `Meter_Location` (integer 255 here, versus the string "unknown"); `common` and `version` are not read by this application. DECISIVE FACT: `site.E_Day` and `site.E_Year` are null here too, exactly as in the Solar API answer — so this path does NOT deliver the day and year energies (docs/UNKNOWNS.md #13). The endpoint is NO LONGER CALLED by the application: the fallback that used it was removed after the captures proved no local source exposes the day and year counters (docs/UNKNOWNS.md #13).
